summary: Pavmed Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an at-the-market offering of up to $9,400,000 in common stock through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, which receives a fixed 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. Sales occur from time to time on Nasdaq under symbol PAVM at prevailing prices; the last reported sale price was $4.72 per share on September 8, 2026. No escrow arrangement exists. This is a routine shelf takedown and, by itself, does not constitute a special situation, though the issuance introduces incremental dilution and supply overhang for holders.
